gameplay.provenance: Actual unaltered production Chromium RU390x844 DPR2. This gameplay-only recording starts fresh and earns one real win through ordinary touch. menus.provenance: Unaltered production Chromium mobile emulation RU390x844 DPR2. Fresh storage, nineteen wins earned by ordinary touch selected with independent cell-walking oracle. Ordinary pinch for gameplay framing. Menu clicks via native DOM click to avoid automation stability waits. The held preview is cancelled through ordinary touch movement. An earned medal flies to Collection on the first return. The explicitly labelled video hint opens directly after three active seconds; browser no-provider failure is shown without a fake ad or reward. No injected progression or achievements. Not physical phone evidence.

localVerification.note: Earlier parallel exploratory runs exposed footer recentering and keyboard focus loss; both have direct regressions and pass in the final 94-case CI. The final focused run additionally passes compact opening, stable HUD/Hint geometry, disclosure, actual earned flight/no replay and bounded idle checks. Local bulk software-rendering timeout is not physical-device performance evidence.

resolvedIssues.issue: First removal cleared the tutorial paragraph, resized the footer and recentered the next tap. Fixed with stable transparent text lane and direction/Hint alignment.
Async Collection metadata refresh could remove a focused summary between Focus and Enter. Stable summary IDs and focus restoration fix it.
